mapper.select: select id, user_id, request_id, session_id, status, safety_decision, error_code, limit_type, retry_after_seconds, retryable, safe_text, ai, lease_token, lease_until, active_slot, completed_at, create_time, update_time, audio_asset_id from npc_chat_request where user_id = #{userId} and request_id = #{requestId}
mapper.update: update npc_chat_request set audio_asset_id=#{assetId},update_time=now() where user_id=#{userId} and request_id=#{requestId} and status='SUCCEEDED' and safety_decision='PASS' and audio_asset_id is null
mapper.insert: insert into npc_chat_request ( user_id, request_id, session_id, status, safety_decision, error_code, limit_type, retry_after_seconds, retryable, safe_text, ai, lease_token, lease_until, active_slot, completed_at, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{userId}, #{requestId}, #{sessionId}, #{status}, #{safetyDecision}, #{errorCode}, #{limitType}, #{retryAfterSeconds}, #{retryable}, #{safeText}, #{ai}, #{leaseToken}, #{leaseUntil}, #{activeSlot}, #{completedAt}, now(), now() )
mapper.update: update npc_chat_request set safety_decision = 'UNKNOWN', error_code = 'REQUEST_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN', retryable = 0, safe_text = #{safeText}, lease_token = null, update_time = now() where user_id = #{userId} and session_id = #{sessionId} and status = 'PROCESSING' and lease_until < now()

update npc_chat_request set status = #{status}, safety_decision = #{safetyDecision}, error_code = #{errorCode}, limit_type = #{limitType}, retry_after_seconds = #{retryAfterSeconds}, retryable = #{retryable}, safe_text = #{safeText}, ai = #{ai}, lease_token = null, lease_until = null, active_slot = null, completed_at = now(), update_time = now() where user_id = #{userId} and request_id = #{requestId} and status = 'PROCESSING' and lease_token = #{leaseToken} and lease_until > now()

update npc_chat_request set lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, update_time = now() where user_id = #{userId} and request_id = #{requestId} and status = 'PROCESSING' and lease_token = #{leaseToken} and lease_until > now()
